Preserve the reference car's distinctive body shape, pale metallic blue paint, black details, wheels, and horseshoe grille. Match the bridge's red suspension towers and cables, bay setting, and clear daylight. Camera tracks alongside and slightly ahead at a front three-quarter angle, keeping the whole car visible while roadway and red bridge structures move naturally past. Car stays in its lane on the road deck, wheels rotate realistically. Natural reflections and coherent geometry. No cuts, no on-screen text. Silent.
